cfb.label: Tuned · September 14
cfb.objective: Net units at original saved prices, one unit per eligible game; MAE tiebreak
cfb.scopeNote: All 58 originally priced college games in the September 9 archive: 1 Thursday, 5 Friday and 52 Saturday. Another 26 modeled games had no saved market. The optimized record is retrospective and remains separate from the recovered Saturday scorecard.
cfb.validationNote: Across 728 earlier games, error changed from 15.43 to 14.86 points; early-season 2026 results were weaker. These are inspected retrospective checks, not fresh validation.

nfl.label: Tuned · September 14
nfl.objective: Net units at original saved prices, one unit per eligible game; MAE tiebreak
nfl.scopeNote: Two original September 9 quotes plus 13 September 13 pregame captures, each modeled at its original cutoff. Monday’s pending game is excluded. This optimization sample combines source archives only for research; the actual scorecards remain separate.
nfl.validationNote: Across 855 earlier games, error worsened from 10.35 to 10.56 points. The higher last-week return did not improve line accuracy.

mlb.label: Tuned · September 14
mlb.objective: Net units at original saved prices, one unit per eligible game; MAE tiebreak
mlb.scopeNote: Only one day of pregame prices survived; this is not a full-week baseball test. All 160 settings retained the same selections and return; lower error broke the tie. Reconstructed history contains 3,016 of the original 3,020 training rows; baseline lines differ by at most 0.0573 runs, with all original selections unchanged.
mlb.validationNote: Across 1,088 games in 12 earlier weeks, error changed from 3.513 to 3.508 runs. This small retrospective difference does not establish an advantage.
